title: Published package does not declare the Node runtime required by node:sqlite
reasoning: @docgit/core imports the built-in node:sqlite module at package import time via the public index export of SnapshotStore, but the package manifest has no engines field constraining consumers to a Node version that provides that module. Consumers on older supported-looking Node versions can install the package and then fail immediately on import or CLI startup.
reproduction: Install or run @docgit/core under a Node version without node:sqlite and import the package entrypoint or run the docgit bin; module loading fails before callers can use non-store APIs.
recommendation: Add a package-level engines.node constraint matching the minimum supported node:sqlite runtime, and align CI/package smoke tests with that minimum. If broader Node support is required, isolate or replace the node:sqlite dependency so importing the package entrypoint does not require it.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests exercise the local development runtime only; there is no package install/import smoke test under the declared minimum runtime.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a pack/install smoke test or CI matrix job that imports @docgit/core and runs the bin under the package's minimum declared Node version.
minimumFixScope: packages/core/package.json engines field, plus CI or package smoke coverage if available.
